title: SGD with Momentum
signature: def sgd_momentum_step(param, grad, buf, lr=0.01, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0) -> tuple
hints: Fold weight decay into the gradient first: g = grad + weight_decay * param.
The buffer accumulates raw gradients: buf = momentum * buf + g. There is no (1 - momentum) factor.
The learning rate is applied when you step, not when you update the buffer: param - lr * buf.
